comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text:
Code review summary for MVP technical-debt review:

Assessment: With debt.

Must-fix-before-release:
- packages/core/src/persistence/schema.ts:3,226: SCHEMA_VERSION is stamped without migrations or compatibility checks.
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/contextAssembler.ts:203,302: current scene transcript is rendered in full, contradicting bounded-context goals.

Later refactor debt:
- Provider auth is validated in config but not injected into AgentSdkModelClient; hosted BYOK needs an explicit auth seam.
- packages/core/src/index.ts exports too broad a public API.
- packages/core/src/memory/summary.ts is a broad 582-line module spanning persistence, rollup policy, validation, selection, and mapping.
- Scene-summary generation is duplicated between orchestrator and sessionClose.
- JSON row mapping/parsing is duplicated across persistence modules.

Packaging/friction debt:
- CLI bin has no shebang in source/build output.
- Node 22 baseline is documented but not enforced in package metadata.
- CLI entrypoint tests skip when dist is missing.
- AGENTS.md test-count expectation is stale.

Follow-up beads created:
- loreweaver-4ik, loreweaver-czv, loreweaver-8uh, loreweaver-lus, loreweaver-1a4, loreweaver-2g7, loreweaver-dsa, loreweaver-vzv, loreweaver-vmp.

Scope/verification: reviewer inspected core persistence/schema/state/memory/context/orchestrator/tools/session/model/config, CLI entrypoint/play loop, package manifests, README/AGENTS guidance, and tests. Reviewer ran npm run test: 35 test files passed, 195 tests passed, 1 skipped. Worktree remained clean.
